common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Assuming SSA (Side-Side-Angle) guarantees congruence in non-right triangles.
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Remember that the angle must be strictly INCLUDED between the two sides for SAS. SSA only guarantees congruence in right triangles (RHS).

common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.common_error_or_misconception: Writing congruence statements without respecting vertex order (e.g. writing ΔABC ≅ ΔZYX when A matches X).
common_pitfalls_editing_checkers.correct_fact_or_method: Always align corresponding vertices in the exact order: if A↔X, B↔Y, C↔Z, write ΔABC ≅ ΔXYZ.

hotspots.label: SSS Criterion
hotspots.popover_text: Side-Side-Side: Equal 3 side lengths guarantee congruence.

hotspots.label: SAS Criterion
hotspots.popover_text: Side-Angle-Side: Angle MUST be strictly included between equal sides.

hotspots.label: ASA Criterion
hotspots.popover_text: Angle-Side-Angle: Two angles and included side align.

hotspots.label: RHS Criterion
hotspots.popover_text: Right-Hypotenuse-Side: Right angle + Hypotenuse + 1 leg equal.
